title: [DEV] LootFarmer: Idle RPG (PAID $2 - 30% discount now) (Looking for feedback)
author: ShekinahDesigns
selftext:
In LootFarmer: Idle RPG, the weapons and outfits your enemies carry can become yours! Defeat monsters, collect their equipment, and equip their gear to change your character's appearance. The stronger the enemies you face, the more valuable their loot can become.

Explore a colorful pixel-art world where collecting equipment, merging duplicates, and improving your character are at the heart of your adventure.

[itch.io](https://shekinawd.itch.io/lootfarmer-idlerpg)

[playstore](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.shekinahwelefuldesigns.lootfarmeridlerpg)  


**I'm looking for feedback on general looks of the game, based on the stores/video and description..** 

**and if you decide to give it a try and buy it, any feedback about the general feel of the game itself.**

**Does it looks good enough? would you think this is made with AI?**



I'm a dev with more than 12 years of experience (6 on game dev), and I've been developing for UNITY for the last 5 years, recently switched to godot because its easier to use AI there and wanted to give it a try (it worked), so i switched to it.

**I made this game using claude, chatgpt and godot**

ChatGPT for planning

Claude for creating the game

Godot as the engine to distribute it.



Feel free to ask questions if you are curious!
